attributes.action: Allow responsible adults access to regulated, non-lethal self-defence devices
attributes.additional_details:
People should have lawful ways to protect themselves when faced with violence. Personal alarms and whistles can alert others, but they may not provide a practical means of protection during an immediate physical attack.

We want the Government to create a strictly regulated framework for approved, non-lethal self-defence devices, with age limits, safety standards, carrying restrictions and strong penalties for misuse. Public safety must remain the priority, with expert consultation.
attributes.background: We want the Government to introduce legislation allowing responsible adults to possess and carry approved, non-lethal self-defence devices, subject to age limits, safety standards, restrictions on where they can be carried and penalties for misuse.

rejection.details:
